summary: Select one known canonical agent in existing assistant metadata reads without fleet output pagination

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema, index, or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing agents and agents-rich reads and st_agents_list accept an optional exact canonical agent_id selector. Unfiltered requests retain existing pagination. Filtering precedes page construction and byte packing; cursors bind the exact selector. No aliases, priorities, conversation content, scopes, or authority are added.

downtime.detail: No added startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action required; clients may refresh tool discovery to use the optional selector.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
